notes.title: Dev Diary #2
notes.content:
The combat system in Greenhaven Realms includes a wide range of parameters, such as your character's stats (weapons and armor), as well as combat skills. The damage dealt to a target depends on the following parameters:

[list]
[*]Your accuracy and the target's evasion.
[*]Your critical hit chance and critical damage modifier.
[*]The target's physical and magical defense.
[*]Your physical and magical armor penetration against the target.
[*]The availability of mana for dealing magical damage.
[*]Elemental damage and the target's elemental resistance.
[/list]

In addition to dealing damage, both you and your enemies can have life and mana steal. Enemies can also possess various skills, such as: increasing armor for a certain number of turns, regenerating health/mana, increasing attack speed, critical hit chance, etc.

The combat skills currently available in the game include:

[list]
[*]Mastery of physical and magical weapons — increases your character's minimum damage threshold.
[*]Evasion — increases the minimum chance of evasion using your evasion stat.
[*]Accuracy — similar to evasion, increases the minimum hit chance using your accuracy stat.
[/list]
